description: Entirely synthetic, fixed request bytes and shape vectors. Positive means schema shape only; CSRF/HMAC/Access signatures and primary authorization are not established by these vectors. Context/strict UTF8/size/idempotency vectors require their stated runtime layer, not JSON Schema alone. Not executed acceptance tests. Existing signature/hash references are updated atomically for required device_epoch. cases/accept ACKs only a device-declared persisted local receipt. Receipt-status IDs denote current observations, not immutable side-effect responses. Approval is returned alongside the signed operation and checked against its signed hash; no extra signature purpose is introduced.
